title: llm-inference-engine
blurb: going a little deeper than calling an API
details: Built a small GPT-2 inference engine in Python using PyTorch and Transformers.
Experimented with KV-cache inference, quantization, and speculative decoding.
Built benchmarks around throughput, memory usage, and output correctness.

title: sftp-pipeline
details: Concurrent SFTP ingestion pipeline written in Go.
Uses worker pools, connection pooling, and retries with exponential backoff.
Benchmarked streaming and in-memory processing to understand the trade-offs between throughput and memory.

title: SocialOrbit
blurb: a social graph you can actually wander through
details: Built an interactive social-graph explorer in TypeScript.
Turns relationships and connections into something you can actually explore.
Built and shipped as a live web app.

title: Namewave
blurb: stuck on a name? let the machine overthink it
details: A simple name generator with a fast, minimal interface.
Built around quick interactions and getting useful results without the clutter.
Designed and shipped as a small Vercel project.

title: Tasker
blurb: a todo app, because apparently I needed to build one
details: Full-stack task manager built with TypeScript.
Covers the usual CRUD and application flows without turning a todo list into a framework demo.
Built to get comfortable with structuring a complete application end to end.

title: LocalDrop
blurb: send files across the room, minus the cloud
details: A lightweight LAN file-sharing utility written in Go.
Lets you move files directly between devices on the same network.
Started as a small practical tool and became an excuse to learn more about networking and Go.
